# Genre Cut Style Guide: Horror
- Hold the stillness before the fright in long Cuts, then land the shock on a sudden change.
- Light detail Cuts only in part, out of the dark.
- Give the uneasy thing its own Cut — the empty space behind a person, the corridor.
- An unannounced Cut still has to join. What makes the jump land rather than read as a mistake is the world written into the first instant of the Cut after it.
